title: Gemini Spark Now Has Chrome Web-Browsing Capabilities
excerpt: Google's AI assistant can "use your logged-in accounts and saved passwords to handle tedious web errands."
content_html:
Google's AI assistant can "use your logged-in accounts and saved passwords to handle tedious web errands."

Google's agentic AI assistant Spark can now integrate with the company's Chrome web browser. Once logged in to Chrome, Spark "can use your logged-in accounts and saved passwords to handle tedious web errands." This is a modern AI tool, so the tedious web errands that Spark handles seem to revolve around "researching flight options and starting the booking process." When did booking flights become the number one pain point of existing?

The company did suggest that it could also be used for "scheduling viewings of apartments." Those are the only two use case examples provided by Google. Engadget has reached out to the company to ask for more information as to what this integration means for actual users. We'll update this post when we hear back.

Google has noted some safety features, for those wary of handing off passwords and log-in information to an AI assistant. The company says there are tools in place to protect against prompt injection, which is when prompts are hidden on malicious websites and user-generated content. These prompts can force the assistant to take unwanted actions, "such as initiating financial transactions or exfiltrating sensitive data."

The company hasn't provided concrete details on these safety tools, other than saying it's "investing in a layered defense that includes both deterministic and probabilistic defenses to make it difficult and costly for attackers to cause harm." Additionally, Spark won't complete payments on its own, handing it back to the user to review and finish the purchase. That's good to know.

This new feature is rolling out now in the US, with more regions to come in the future. To that end, the company just expanded Spark access to Google AI Pro subscribers in over 160 countries. The AI assistant also integrates with Google's Workspace apps.

content_html_zh:
谷歌的人工智能助手可以“使用您登录的帐户和保存的密码来处理繁琐的网络事务”。

谷歌的代理人工智能助手 Spark 现在可以与该公司的 Chrome 网络浏览器集成。 登录 Chrome 后，Spark“可以使用您登录的帐户和保存的密码来处理繁琐的网络事务。” 这是一种现代人工智能工具，因此 Spark 处理的繁琐的网络任务似乎围绕“研究航班选项并开始预订流程”。 什么时候订机票成为现有的第一痛点？

该公司确实建议它也可以用于“安排公寓看房”。 这是 Google 提供的仅有的两个用例示例。 Engadget 已联系该公司，要求提供有关此集成对实际用户意味着什么的更多信息。 当我们收到回复后，我们会更新这篇文章。

谷歌已经注意到了一些安全功能，对于那些担心将密码和登录信息交给人工智能助手的人来说。 该公司表示，有一些工具可以防止提示注入，即提示隐藏在恶意网站和用户生成的内容中。 这些提示可能会迫使助手采取不需要的操作，“例如启动金融交易或泄露敏感数据”。

该公司尚未提供有关这些安全工具的具体细节，只是表示正在“投资于分层防御，其中包括确定性防御和概率防御，以使攻击者难以造成伤害，且成本高昂。” 此外，Spark 不会自行完成付款，而是将其交还给用户以审核并完成购买。 很高兴知道这一点。

这项新功能现已在美国推出，未来还会在更多地区推出。 为此，该公司刚刚将 Spark 访问权限扩展到 160 多个国家/地区的 Google AI Pro 订阅者。 人工智能助手还与谷歌的 Workspace 应用程序集成。
